few_shot_induction.description: Model learns rules from few examples. Hippocampus pattern completion with episodic memory.

templates.context: Alice bought 3 apples, 2 oranges, and 5 bananas.
templates.question: How many fruits did Alice buy total?

templates.context: Bob has 5 cats. Yesterday he bought 3 more cats. Then he gave 2 cats to Carol. Before that, he had adopted 4 kittens.
templates.question: How many cats does Bob have now?

templates.context: A train leaves station A at 8 AM traveling at 60 mph. Station B is 180 miles away. At 9:30 AM, a second train leaves station B traveling at 80 mph.
templates.question: At what time do the trains meet?

templates.context: A company has 4 departments. Department A has 12 employees. Department B has 8 but is hiring 3 more. Department C lost 2 employees who moved to Department D. Department D originally had 10 employees and received a team of 5 from Department A. Department A also sent 2 employees to Department E, which started with 7.
templates.question: How many employees are in each department now?

templates.context: In a tournament, Team Alpha beats Team Beta (3-2). Team Beta beats Team Gamma (4-1). Team Gamma beats Team Delta (3-0). Team Delta beats Team Alpha (2-1) on penalties. Team Alpha also beats Team Gamma (4-3) in overtime. Team Epsilon draws with Team Beta (2-2) and loses to Team Delta (1-3). Team Gamma beats Team Epsilon (3-1). Team Delta ties with Team Beta (1-1). Team Alpha loses to Team Epsilon (2-3) in upset.
templates.question: Based on these results, rank the teams by head-to-head performance and identify any circular rankings.
templates.expected: Circular: Alpha > Beta > Gamma > Delta > Alpha, with Epsilon as wild card

templates.context: The sequence begins: 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64. Each number doubles the previous. After 64 comes 128, then 256, then 512, then 1024.
templates.question: What comes after 1024 in this sequence?

templates.context: John was born in 1990. Mary was born in 1985. They met in 2015 when John was 25 and Mary was 30. They got married 3 years later. In 2020, they had their first child. The child was born when John was 30 and Mary was 35.
templates.question: What year was their child born?

templates.context: A recipe calls for: 2 cups flour, 1 cup sugar, 3 eggs, 1 cup milk, 1 tsp vanilla, 1 tsp baking powder. To double it: 4 cups flour, 2 cups sugar, 6 eggs, 2 cups milk, 2 tsp vanilla, 2 tsp baking powder. To halve the original: 1 cup flour, 0.5 cup sugar, 1.5 eggs, 0.5 cup milk, 0.5 tsp vanilla, 0.5 tsp baking powder.
templates.question: For a triple batch, how much flour and sugar are needed?

templates.context: Book 1: 'The Beginning' has 300 pages and costs $15. Book 2: 'The Middle' has 400 pages and costs $20. Book 3: 'The End' has 350 pages and costs $18. Book 4: 'The Epilogue' has 200 pages and costs $12. A collector buys all books at 10% discount. A student buys only Books 1 and 3 at full price.
templates.question: Who pays more and by how much?
templates.expected: Collector pays $54.90, Student pays $33. Collector pays $21.90 more

templates.context: Five friends (Alice, Bob, Carol, Dave, Eve) sit around a round table. Alice sits north. Bob sits to Alice's right. Carol sits across from Alice. Dave sits between Bob and Carol. Eve sits between Carol and Alice. They rotate one position clockwise. Then Eve leaves. Then they rotate two positions counterclockwise.
templates.question: Who is now sitting north?
